'''Zha Quanxing''' ({{zh|c=査全性|p=Zhā Quánxìng}}; April 11, 1925 – August 1, 2019) was a Chinese electrochemist who served as Professor and Chair of the Department of Chemistry of [[Wuhan University]]. He was elected an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] in 1980.

==Biography==
Zha was born in [[Nanjing]], [[Jiangsu]], on April 11, 1925,<ref>[https://www.thepaper.cn/newsDetail_forward_4060570 悲痛！倡导恢复高考第一人、武汉大学查全性院士今晨辞世] 1 August 2019. Chinese. Thepaper.</ref> the son of Zha Qian, a physicist and the first president of [[Huazhong University of Science and Technology]]. His [[Ancestral home (Chinese)|ancestral home]] was in [[Jing County, Anhui|Jing County]], [[Anhui]].<ref>{{cite news|url=http://news.163.com/19/0801/11/ELG8OF1R0001899N.html |script-title=zh:倡导恢复高考第一人查全性院士因病离世 享年95岁|trans-title=Academician Zha Quanxing, who first proposed that the college entrance examination should be resumed, died at the age of 95 |work=163.com |date=2019-08-01 |language=zh}}</ref> He joined the [[Chinese Communist Party]] in 1949. In 1950 he graduated from [[Wuhan University]], where he majored in chemistry. From 1957 to 1959, he went to [[Moscow State University]] to study under electrochemist [[Alexander Frumkin]]. He returned to China in 1959 and that year became teacher at his [[alma mater]]. In August 1977, he was invited to attend a scientific and educational symposium held at the [[Great Hall of the People]] in [[Beijing]], at which he first proposed that the college entrance examination should be resumed, with [[Deng Xiaoping]]'s consent.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://news.sina.com.cn/c/2019-08-01/doc-ihytcitm6123933.shtml |script-title=zh:“倡导恢复高考第一人”查全性院士今晨辞世|trans-title=Academician Zha Quanxing, who first proposed that the college entrance examination should be resumed, died this morning |work=Sina |date=2019-08-01 |language=zh}}</ref> He was promoted to Professor in 1978 and Chair of the Department of Chemistry of Wuhan University the following year. He was elected an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] in 1980. He died on August 1, 2019, at the age of 94.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://news.sina.com.cn/o/2019-08-01/doc-ihytcerm7786215.shtml |script-title=zh:著名电化学家查全性逝世 中国5天内痛失2位院士|trans-title=Famous electrochemist Zha Quanxing is dead, two academicians died in five days in China |work=Sina |date=2019-08-01 |language=zh}}</ref>
